notes:
Top-line: TicketSmith is an ecommerce CX platform (order issues, refunds, chargebacks). Evaluating Redwood for agent-assist + tool-calling to orchestrate ticket create/update and execute refunds via Payments API.

Key constraints/asks (from AE/SE & CTO):
- SLO: sub-200ms median for lookup calls; 99.9% availability during holiday spikes (Black Friday).
- Tool-calling patterns: create ticket in Zendesk, attach AI summary + call transcript, call internal Payments GraphQL to attempt refund (idempotent), escalate to Ops with incident creation when refund fails or fraud flags.
- Required guarantees: idempotency tokens, ordered delivery semantics for updates, retry/backoff with dedupe, full audit trail for compliance.
- Security: must support SSO/SAML, KMS integration for keys, long-term audit logging, and data residency controls for EU customers. PCI scope: payments team insists on PII minimization and clear redaction in transcripts.

Stack & integration notes:
- Existing: Zendesk (ticket store), Snowflake (logs), Kafka for events, internal Payments GraphQL service (refunds), Okta for SSO.
- Want Redwood to call: Zendesk API (create/update/attachments), Payments API (refunds/refunds-status), internal escalations endpoint to create incident tickets in PagerDuty.

Quotes / paraphrases from calls:
- "If the AI suggests a refund, we want the agent to be able to click 'execute' and have it happen with audit metadata — no manual steps." (VP Ops)
- "We cannot accept duplicate refunds — idempotency is non-negotiable." (Payments eng lead)

Recent compliance steps: security questionnaire v2 sent (drive link), legal asked for SOC2 addendum and encryption at rest details. SE did a preliminary latency benchmark against a small model under synthetic load (attached).

POC goals:
- 1-week smoke: Redwood dedicated pool in VPC, end-to-end tool call to create ticket & simulate refund (sandbox payments).
- 2-week run: scale to 500 concurrent agent sessions, measure median latency and failure rates, validate retry logic and audit logs.

Stubs/links: Fireflies ff_20241021_8912 (discovery), ff_20241105_9033 (security deep-dive). Gmail thread-1682912 has contract questions. Drive: TS-Architecture-VPC (network requirements), ticketsmith-poc-runbook (runbook draft). Jira: INF-1223 (initial integration questions), INF-1287 (latency benchmark follow-up).

Sales notes (AE):
- Deal appetite moderate-high — wallet: multi-region dedicated pools + Optimize advisory.
- Next: align legal and payments team, exchange test creds, schedule POC kickoff the week of 2024-11-18.

Short internal ask: prepare runbook for Payments API idempotency and example webhook mapping for Zendesk attachment flow.
